ananya.summary: Herbal / personal-care manufacturer offering formulation + in-house packaging.

signals.oneLine: Herbal & personal-care contract maker with in-house packaging. Low public-news profile — the read is in the financials (8 years on file).

anuspa.summary: Private-label / contract soap & personal-care maker (Himachal + Mumbai) with a blue-chip client roster.

signals.oneLine: Contract-makes soaps for Unilever, ITC, Godrej, MamaEarth, Kama Ayurveda & Sun Pharma — ~6 cr cakes/month, 700+ formulations. Diversified across big clients, so less dependent on any one buyer. But CARE rates them 'B' (sub-investment-grade) — probe their cash position.

cheryl.summary: Navi Mumbai cosmeceutical R&D + contract manufacturer with a dermatological focus.

signals.oneLine: Innovation-driven formulation & contract manufacturer in the dermatological / cosmeceutical segment (private-label, ready-to-market). No major public developments recently.

ngelectro.summary: PE-backed contract manufacturer (home care, beauty & personal care, nutraceuticals) — JM Financial invested ₹150 cr (2026).

news.title: JM Financial PE leads ₹150 crore investment in NG Electro Products
news.oneLine: Growth capital to expand capacity, R&D and compliance — a contract manufacturer scaling across home & personal care and nutraceuticals.

signals.oneLine: Fresh PE money (JM Financial) for capacity + R&D — well-funded and expanding, so they want volume to fill new lines; a stronger balance sheet also means less cash desperation on terms.

EPL Limited.summary: World's largest laminated-tube maker (ex-Essel Propack); Blackstone is selling its stake to Indorama Ventures.

news.title: Blackstone selling its EPL stake; Indorama Ventures acquiring (CCI-approved)
news.oneLine: Ownership transition at ₹240/share — promoter holding down to 26.4% (Jun 2025); a new strategic owner incoming.

news.title: EPL declares ₹2.50 interim dividend for FY26
news.oneLine: LTM revenue ₹4,137 cr, EBITDA ₹806 cr (~17% YoY) — a healthy, growing listed supplier.

signals.oneLine: Blackstone → Indorama Ventures — a strategic (not PE) owner incoming: likely stable and long-term, but a global packaging major with scale. Listed, well-capitalised, CARE AA, growing 17% — they can hold price; push on multi-year volume & service, not distress.

Manjushree Technopack Limited.summary: Ownership in flux — Advent is selling Manjushree to PAG for ~$1bn, which shelves its planned ₹3,000 cr IPO.

news.title: Advent agrees to sell Manjushree Technopack to PAG for close to $1 billion
news.oneLine: US PE firm Advent (owner since 2018) exits to PAG at ~$1bn enterprise value — PAG's largest India deal to date.

news.title: Manjushree Technopack IPO was on the fast track — ₹3,000 cr (₹2,250 cr OFS + ₹750 cr fresh)
news.oneLine: IPO plan now overtaken by the PAG sale; FY24 revenue ₹2,130 cr, capacity ~1.9 lakh tonnes/yr.

news.title: PAG to acquire Manjushree Technopack
news.oneLine: Confirms PAG's buyout of India's largest rigid-plastic packaging maker.

signals.oneLine: Advent → PAG (~$1bn). A fresh PE owner will push hard for returns — expect cost discipline and pricing pressure; the ownership transition is a window to lock terms.

Pragati Glass & Industries Pvt. Ltd.summary: Container-glass (bottles/jars) manufacturer for cosmetics, pharma & F&B.

signals.oneLine: Established container-glass maker serving cosmetics / pharma / F&B packaging. No major public developments in recent months — the read is in the financials.

PRINTOTECH GLOBAL LIMITED.summary: Seamless & laminated tube-packaging maker for cosmetics, pharma & oral care (since 1994).

signals.oneLine: Makes laminated/seamless tubes for cosmetics & personal care on German extrusion + Swiss decoration lines; BRCGS-certified, recyclable/EPR-compliant. Quality is their moat — compete them on price by qualifying a second tube source.

Radcom Packaging.summary: Cleanroom (cGMP / ISO 15378) maker of PET/HDPE bottles, jars & caps for cosmetics & pharma (Vasai, since 2011).

signals.oneLine: Two Class-1-lakh cleanroom facilities with USDMF & cGMP approvals — pharma-grade packaging. Compliance makes them sticky and gives pricing power; qualify a second cGMP source to keep them honest.

SAMKIN TREASURE MOLDERS PRIVATE LIMITED.summary: Cosmetics packaging maker — PET bottles, jars, caps & shampoo bottles (Gujarat, since 1998).

signals.oneLine: Makes PET bottles, cosmetic/cream jars, caps and shampoo bottles from Ankleshwar/Vadodara. Commodity packaging with many interchangeable makers — leverage sits with the buyer; multi-source to hold price.

SICON PACKS PRIVATE LIMITED.summary: Sicon Packs achieved GMI print certification and is investing in a new Orthotec FLX3028 flexographic press.

news.title: Sicon Packs Pvt Ltd: Raising the Bar in Sustainable, High-Performance Labeling
news.oneLine: Achieved GMI certification and investing in new Orthotec FLX3028 flexo press

beemanpharmaceuticals.summary: Identity confirmed as a Mumbai-based chemical/API/vitamin trader, but no significant recent news found.

connellbrothers.summary: Now part of Caldic-Connell — the Advent-backed global specialty-ingredients distributor (~€3bn sales, 43 countries).

news.title: Caldic and Connell complete merger — a global specialty-chemicals distributor (~€3bn sales)
news.oneLine: Advent International + Wilbur-Ellis merge Caldic and Connell; the India business now runs under the Connell Caldic (APAC) brand.

news.title: Caldic acquires Chemhouse Marketing and Brink Chemicals in India
news.oneLine: Bolt-on of two India personal-care ingredient distributors, integrated into the APAC organisation.

signals.oneLine: Advent-backed inside a €3bn global distributor. Deep principal ties and scale — but a distributor model means their price is largely a pass-through; push on the distributor margin, not the molecule.

psteaindstries.summary: Drama Llama / P.S. Tea Industries is a tea and coffee beverage company, not a cosmetics/chemicals/packaging supplier; identity does not match.

givaudan.summary: Global flavours & fragrances leader; made its biggest-ever India plant investment and keeps expanding across Asia.

news.title: Givaudan lays foundation for a new savoury-flavours facility in Nantong, China
news.oneLine: Continued Asia-Pacific capacity expansion strengthening regional production.

signals.oneLine: Invested ~CHF 55m in its Indian plant (biggest India commitment since 1998) — a growing local operation that needs volume to fill capacity; leverage for volume-linked pricing.

kayceeenterprise.summary: Could not confirm identity of a specific Indian cosmetics/chemicals supplier named 'kaycee enterprise' (multiple unrelated 'Kay Cee' chemical firms exist); no news.

nirmaancosmetic.summary: Identity confirmed as a Mumbai cosmetic raw material firm incorporated March 2025, but too new with no significant news found.

signals.oneLine: Established aroma-chemicals and fragrance maker with in-house R&D; a recognised industry supplier. No major public developments in recent months.

valuetree.summary: Acquired by Dutch distributor IMCD (Jan 2024) — now part of a global specialty-ingredients group.

news.title: IMCD acquires Indian beauty-ingredients distributor Valuetree
news.oneLine: IMCD buys Valuetree (FY23 revenue ~₹440 cr / €48m, 44 staff); distribution spans India, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, China, Indonesia, Pakistan, Nepal.

signals.oneLine: Now IMCD-owned (IMCD is the 70% holder in its filings). A global parent brings deeper pockets and principal ties — but also group margin targets; test their pricing flexibility.

yashamspecialityingredientspvtltd.summary: Specialty-ingredients distributor & manufacturer (since 1997) across pharma, personal care, food & nutraceuticals.

signals.oneLine: Techno-commercial distributor bringing global principals to India (Mumbai HQ + Delhi & Bangalore). Keeps a low public-news profile — the leverage sits in its financials, not headlines.
